newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 4,365 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 4,365 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 4,365 contracts compared with 1,274 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 431 wheat, 1,296 corn, 2,098 soybean, 163 soymeal, 243 soyoil, 16 oat, four corn calls, 102 corn puts, nine soybean calls and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was three to four cents per bushel higher, corn was three to 5-3/4 cents higher and soybeans were 5-1/2 to 17-1/4 cents per bushel higher.
